_doc: Progression rules (tables). Scalar weights for the score formulas are in tuning/career_tuning.tres ('Recruiting', 'Draft', 'Pro Contracts'). College tiers: min_recruiting / min_gpa to get an offer from that tier; offer type by margin over min_recruiting (full scholarship >= full_margin, partial >= 0, preferred walk-on >= walk_on_margin). Tier also sets team strength, exposure (multiplies draft score gains), longest field goal attempts and extra pressure. Draft rounds by draft score; undrafted with score >= udfa_min gets a camp invite (tryout), below it an open free-agent tryout. Tryouts are field goal series in the kick scene: make at least 'need' of 'distances'.

offers._offers_doc: New offers after each high school season (index = season in stage, 1-based: freshman 0, sophomore 1, junior 2, senior 3). Each tier you qualify for adds up to per_tier schools. Offers whose tier you later fall below by more than rescind_margin (or whose GPA minimum you drop below) are withdrawn.

contracts._doc: Salaries are fictional league dollars per season.
